title: pstack in practice: 3 cases and 5 tips for working with agents
summary: Three practical ways to use pstack: compare website prototypes before choosing a design, measure where an app is slow, and recover earlier decisions from code and chat history.

zh.title: pstack 實戰：3 個案例，5 個讓 agent 更好用的技巧
zh.summary: 這篇用三個案例介紹 pstack：用 prototypes 比較網站設計，避免太早選定方向；用 baseline 和 trace 找出 app 的效能瓶頸；和利用程式與歷史對話找回先前的決策脈絡。

title: The core of pstack: verification skills that let agents check their own work
summary: AI agents can already write plenty of code. But once they finish, someone still has to open the app, click through the flow, report the errors, and check whether the next fix actually works.
imageAlt: A blueprint of the pstack verification workflow

zh.title: pstack 最重要的一環: verification skills, 讓 agent 自己驗證
zh.summary: AI agent 已經能寫出不少程式。但寫完之後，常常還是要有人打開 app、點過一遍流程、把錯誤訊息貼回去，再確認修正有沒有生效。
